title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — October 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.1 (Peaked October 21, 2026 at 08:20 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 398 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 4

Several compact active regions and small sunspot groups are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no obvious large outward structure.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
